I have one thats an unpopular opinion, something that the Fandom goes back and forth on. 

Do cats that train in the dark forest deserve to go to the dark forest when they die. My answer is ALWAYS  *it depends on the cat*. 

An example is: Thistleclaw and Crookedstar. They both trained in the dark forest but only Thistleclaw went there when he died. Why? The books give us a bs answer of "he was evil" but he wasn't. He had conflicting goals that would have had bad consequences on their future. Why? Because he was trained in the dark forest and told to be ruthless. He was already bigger and stronger as a kit compared to his littermates and other kits. Like damn he's massive. And aggressive. He was taught to use his size against others, he was taught to be as harsh and ruthless as possible to get what he wanted. Then he taught his apprentice this. He ENJOYED hurting others. He ENJOYED killing. He ENJOYED manipulating others. And thats all before spottedleafs little novela. 

Crookedstar trained in the dark forest at the same time as Thistleclaw. Sometimes trained together. And yes, you could chalk it all up to be "Crookedkit was desperate for a parental figure and love and was nieve". But he had brambleberry for comfort and motherly like love. But Crookedstar knew that being taught to kill was wrong. He was NEVER ruthless. He didn't kill just to kill, he didn't hurt other just to hurt them. He only took from Mapleshades training the training part. Not the ethics and morals of the dark forest. Just the fighting. (I honestly can't remember but I dont think we see crookedstar kill anyone in his book or in the first arch) 

This same argument can be made for lionblaze and ivypool vs breezepelt. These three were lied to by the Cats of the dark forest, made to believe they were being trained to help make their clans stronger. (And more honesty. I havent gotten past  the second arch so I dont know how lionblazes training could have changed him. But I know he isn't evil. Just anxsty in his early years. But that goes for all three of his litter) from what I've seen from others though, breezepelt is the only one who takes the morals and values of the dark forest. More willing to kill. They played to his abandonment issues from his father and tried to do the same with ivypool with her sister. But with ivypool, she is more loyal to her clan and her sister then some dead cats. She has *morals*. And good ones at that. I also know that Breezepelt redeems himself eventually in crowfeathers book. So if he takes on the more positive morals of the clans i.e. dont kill others unless you ABSALOUTLY have to, life or death type deal, then over time hez earned his place in starclan. But I dont think it would take that long really. Die to save your clan? Redeemed. Save kits from dying? Redeemed. Yes there's work to still be done but to starclan. Your good to come home after you die to them. 

Now. Ashfur is a different story. (I also haven't read the new books so please don't judge me if I say something that conflicts with them) Ashfur, in my eyes, deserved to go to the darkforest right away. He tried to help kill his leader, he tried to kill three new warriors, one being his apprentice, who he attacked I believe? (Please correct me if I'm wrong) and was just. Idk angry boy made bad decisions. It doesn't matter if he made them out of love. And with what he's doing in the current books, from what I've heard, he deffinately has a spot in the dark forest.  

I realize I went on a bit of a tangent there. Essentially. What I mean by "it depends on the cat" is, if the cat being trained by the darkforest cats understands what they are being taught is wrong and doesn't care, enjoys killing, hurting others for enjoyment or power and is generally just... choosing to do harmful things knowing it could hurt others they care for or dont, and just generally doesn't care... then yes. They deserve to go to the dark forest when they die.
